descriptionChirho: A natural flowing body of water, ranging from small streams to major rivers such as the Jordan and Euphrates. Used both literally of geographical waterways and in apocalyptic imagery (rivers of living water, the river of life in Revelation). Consistently rendered: Spanish 'rio/rios', Hindi 'nadi' (नदी/नदियाँ), Arabic 'nahr' (نَهْر) and 'anhaar' (الأَنْهَارِ), Korean 'gang' (강/강들), Swahili 'mto/mito'. The three clusters represent only singular cases, plural forms, and a genitive plural construction of the same concept.
